title: Liraglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes
authors: Marso SP, Daniels GH, Brown-Frandsen K, Kristensen P, Mann JF, Nauck MA, et al.
population: Type 2 diabetes with glycated haemoglobin of 7.0% or more and high cardiovascular risk
funder: Supported by Novo Nordisk and by grants from the National Institutes of Health. A steering committee of 11 academic investigators and 4 sponsor employees designed the protocol in collaboration with the sponsor; the sponsor performed site monitoring and data collection; the data were analysed by Statogen Consulting and the sponsor; editorial support was funded by the sponsor.
authorConflicts: Four authors were employees of and held stock in Novo Nordisk; most other authors reported fees or grants from Novo Nordisk and other companies.
result: Cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction or non-fatal stroke in 608 of 4668 (13.0%) with liraglutide versus 694 of 4672 (14.9%) with placebo (HR 0.87, 95% CI 0.78 to 0.97); median follow-up 3.8 years; number needed to treat 66 over 3 years.
